Dogs with Chronic Renal Insufficiency can benefit from being fed a specially formulated diet, with specific nutrients to help support optimal health and wellbeing. ROYAL CANIN® Renal in Gravy is a renal wet dog food with thin slices in gravy. This product provides tailored nutrition to support adult dogs with Chronic Renal Insufficiency.


ROYAL CANIN® Renal wet food for dogs is suitable for:
•	Dogs with azotaemic Chronic Kidney Disease (IRIS stage 2 to stage 4).
•	Dogs with chronic Kidney Disease with proteinuria (IRIS stage 1 to 4).

•	Renal support
o	This formula contains a moderate level of very high-quality proteins to help support kidney function. Renal insufficiency prevents the kidneys from being able to effectively filter phosphorus from the bloodstream, so ROYAL CANIN® Renal Special is formulated with a low phosphorus content.

To cater to each dog's individual preferences, ROYAL CANIN® Renal is also available as dry food. Texture variety can help to stimulate your dog's appetite. If your dog enjoys a mixed diet of wet and dry food, be sure to reference the on-pack feeding guides to ensure a healthy daily food intake for your dog. ROYAL CANIN® Renal Veterinary diets are specially formulated to support dogs with Chronic Renal Insufficiency.
